information:
**Attendees are required to read the [safety precautions tab](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanDiegoSpring2022#18305-covid-19-safety-precautions) in its entirety.**

**Before registering, please familiarize yourself with [competitor responsibilities](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/SanDiegoSpring2022#18304-staff).**

* This competition will be held in the Quad area of Canyon Crest Academy high school in San Diego.
* Please provide adult supervision for children under 12 years of age.
